premise: Hedgehog rolls in leaves to look grand for the leaf parade and ends up a leaf ball; Mouse and Squirrel pluck him out and everyone wears one leaf.
inspiration: The Jackdaw in Borrowed Feathers (Aesop), turned: nobody laughs at the one who overdressed; friends unpick him and share the costume.
lesson: One leaf, worn with friends, is grander than a hundred.

en-US.title: Hedgehog's Leaf Coat
en-US.text: {tree:sway loop 0.4} Autumn! Leaves were falling, red and gold and brown. Today is the leaf parade, said Squirrel, {squirrel:hop x2} and everybody wears one leaf. Hedgehog wanted to look grand. One leaf? He wanted all of them. So he {hedgehog:spin} rolled, and rolled, and rolled through the biggest pile. Crunch. He stood up. He was not a hedgehog any more. He was a ball of leaves with a nose. {hedgehog:wobble x2} I can't see, said the ball. Oh dear! Mouse {mouse:hop} came running. Squirrel came {squirrel:hop} running. Hold still, they said. Pluck! Pluck! Pluck! Out came Hedgehog, {hedgehog:puff} pink and blinking. Then Mouse picked one red leaf and set it on Hedgehog's head. Squirrel took a gold one. Mouse took a brown one. And off they went, {hedgehog:hop} {squirrel:hop} {mouse:hop} three friends, three leaves, the grandest parade in the forest.

es-ES.title: El abrigo de hojas de Erizo
es-ES.text: {tree:sway loop 0.4} ¡Otoño! Caían las hojas, rojas, doradas y marrones. Hoy es el desfile de las hojas, dijo Ardilla, {squirrel:hop x2} y cada uno lleva una hoja. Erizo quería estar elegante. ¿Una hoja? Él las quería todas. Así que {hedgehog:spin} rodó, y rodó, y rodó por el montón más grande. Cruch. Se levantó. Ya no era un erizo. Era una bola de hojas con nariz. {hedgehog:wobble x2} No veo nada, dijo la bola. ¡Ay, ay! Ratón {mouse:hop} vino corriendo. Ardilla vino {squirrel:hop} corriendo. Quieto, dijeron. ¡Plac! ¡Plac! ¡Plac! Y salió Erizo, {hedgehog:puff} rosadito y parpadeando. Entonces Ratón cogió una hoja roja y se la puso a Erizo en la cabeza. Ardilla cogió una dorada. Ratón, una marrón. Y allá se fueron, {hedgehog:hop} {squirrel:hop} {mouse:hop} tres amigos, tres hojas, el desfile más elegante del bosque.
